results.title: Homo Homini
results.overview: After the cremation of his beloved dog, Savva is heartbroken. On his way home, he drops the box on a stenciled inscription on the pavement. Thinking that it is a sign from his dead friend, he calls the number on the inscription. Soon, a prostitute Anya appears on his doorstep. Anya deceives him and steals the box, thinking that it contains jewelry. Savva calls the number again and goes to the address. In the brothel, Savva finds the box, defeats his offenders, but now Anya is in danger. He saves her, she runs after him and asks for forgiveness. Villainous bullets overtake both - but Savva is saved by the box ... And Savva himself must save Anya.

results.title: Well Done
results.overview: The absurdity of social facades in the most ordinary microcosm.

results.title: You're Dead to Me
results.overview: A group of high school seniors face the challenges of graduation and college while a serial killer stalks their town.

results.title: Crisis
results.overview: In a dystopian future, Lucía, a young philosophy student, secludes herself in her grandparents' summer house. Her solitude is only hindered by the ‘Sistema Único de Salud’, which summons her for a new compulsory vaccination that she does not want to comply with, and she has only five days to solve the problem. Time moves forward between memories and encounters that Lucía has with her partner, her best friend and an unexpected visitor. In a poetic key, the film proposes a reflection on individual freedom and freedom of thought as the last trench in the face of a coercive system.

results.title: Manitou's Canoe
results.overview: Abahachi, the Apache chief, and his white blood brother Ranger fight tirelessly for peace and justice - but a new, up-and-coming gang is making life particularly difficult for them! They lure Abahachi and Ranger into a trap in order to get their hands on the legendary “Canoe of Manitou”.

results.title: Guns & Moses
results.overview: Mo Zaltzman is a beloved Hasidic rabbi in a dusty desert town. When his congregation is violently attacked, police quickly arrest a young white nationalist who threatened them in the past, but Rabbi Mo doesn’t believe the troubled teen is a killer. Since no one else will investigate, Rabbi Mo becomes the detective. As bodies pile up, he must learn how to use a gun to battle the real enemy.

results.title: Malecón
results.overview: After a tragic incident in which he kills his abusive stepfather, Elvis is sent to prison and separated from his childhood sweetheart, Yuli. Once released he is dragged into the sordid world of prostitution in Cuba and faces a critical decision: fight to win back Yuli's love or flee to the United States and start a new life.

results.title: Barbie Boomer
results.overview: A touching portrait of Sylvie Longpré, known for over 20 years as the "Barbie of Quebec," who dedicated much of her life to the famous doll.

results.title: Babylon Club
results.overview: Danny Ocean wants to take his fans to a tropical paradise where they can relax and feel good about the music of his album “Babylon Club.”

results.title: FUR
results.overview: When a small town is terrorized by mysterious creature in a shabby bear suit, all hell breaks loose. But it's not just any bear - It's a zombie with a taste for blood.

results.title: Blunt Force
results.overview: Last night, Amy and Danny attempted to kill their progressive congressman at a motel. As they come to terms with their actions over breakfast, their terrified victim wakes up, ready for revenge.

results.title: The Secret of Growing Gold
results.overview: Based on the story by Bram Stoker, in this short, pseudo-vintage silent film a man brings his new wife home, but his past deeds endanger the couple's future.

results.title: Clarence: Rhythm of the Guitar
results.overview: The story of Clarence Wijewardena, who rewrote the flow of Sinhala music with use of the electric guitar in the 60s.

results.title: Angels & Co.
results.overview: Paul and Léa should never have met. But ever since, they've been irresistibly drawn to each other. Raphaëlle and Gabriel, two angels who are complete opposites, are forced to team up to put everything back in order and prevent these two humans from falling in love. If the angels fail, ambitious Raphaëlle can kiss her promotion to archangel goodbye. As for the swindler Gabriel, he'll be deposed and must spend eternity on Earth.

results.title: Rebel Royals: An Unlikely Love Story
results.original_title: Rebel Royals: An Unlikely Love Story
results.overview: This exclusive documentary goes behind the scenes with Märtha Louise and Shaman Durek Verrett in the lead-up to their divisive wedding in Norway.

results.title: She Said Maybe
results.overview: When German-raised Mavi learns she belongs to a superrich Turkish dynasty, new family expectations quickly turn her world and love life upside down.

results.title: Fragile
results.overview: When Janet confronts her brother Marvin about how success has changed him, tensions flare. Once close, the siblings now stand worlds apart—Marvin, a high-powered film and TV writer/Director, polished and distant; Janet, grounded and unwilling to ignore the person he’s become. But as their heated argument unfolds in his cold, immaculate kitchen, things begin to feel off about this interaction. Are these their true feelings of is there something deeper—something that we are not quite seeing yet?

results.title: Group Therapy
results.overview: A group of six people, all struggling with various mental afflictions and life circumstances, come together to be led to self fulfillment by their zany and free spirited therapist.

results.title: Itacoatiaras
results.overview: In Itacoatiaras, two distant places, one in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, and the other in Amazonas, share a name and a history rooted in Indigenous lands. As both face the erasure of their ancestral identity through development and environmental destruction, the film explores memory, territory, and the climate crisis through the voices of Indigenous leaders, activists, environmentalists, and researchers.
